name: Geostationary Imager Observation Request Builder Nodes
description: Request-builder flow nodes for geostationary imager observations in NOAA Open Data Dissemination's anonymous public buckets (GOES-East noaa-goes19 and GOES-West noaa-goes18: ABI L1b/L2 NetCDF4 under <product>/<YYYY>/<DDD>/<HH>/). plan turns a timer tick into one S3 ListObjectsV2 request per (satellite, product folder) of the frame hour; select_files takes the listings and emits, for each wanted field, the hour's first full-disk scan as GET requests - byte ranges when a file is larger than imager_max_part_bytes, each response well under the host's 100 MiB cap - with a parse job per part, ONE FILE PER INVOCATION, yielding the rest as backlog so the parser holds one file and storage-ingest receives one meta and one record stream at a time; publish_request turns a completed storage-ingest result plus the parser's ingest meta into the dataset-publication POST for the node's loopback admin endpoint (nothing when imager_publish_url is unset). Every request sets If-Modified-Since at the epoch so the host never turns a repeat listing or a second byte range into an empty 304. Node CONFIG through plugin.getConfig: imager_live_access (default true), imager_satellites, imager_fields (default the five the world-clouds display reads), imager_widths, imager_frame_time (default the latest hour imager_lag_minutes old), imager_max_part_bytes, timeouts, imager_publish_url. No credentials: capabilities none.

sequentialJustification.detail: Each method turns its control frames into request/job frames in one pass: plan reads the node config once and emits listing requests, select_files parses the listings and queues one entry per file, publish_request pairs one result with one meta. The only state is select_files's queue of pending files, drained one per invocation as the compiled runtime resumes the yielded node; no worker pool and no thread.

methods.description: Timer tick -> one S3 ListObjectsV2 GET per (satellite, product folder) of the frame hour, each with a list job naming the satellite, sensor, bucket, prefix, frame time, fields and widths; one status frame when live access is off. One tick per invocation (a surplus is refused as batched-input-frames).

wildcardJustification.detail: Cron timer tick frame produced by the flow runtime and consumed inside this flow only; it carries no payload of its own, so there is no SDS record to name.
hostcap/http-request request descriptor ({method,url,headers,timeoutMs,responseWire}) produced and consumed inside this flow; its shape is defined by the host http.request op, not by SDS.

outputPorts.description: One listing request per (satellite, product folder).

wildcardJustification.detail: Per-listing job (satellite, sensor, bucket, prefix, frame time, fields, widths) consumed by select_files inside the same flow; never persisted.

outputPorts.description: One list job per listing request, in the same order.

wildcardJustification.detail: Cycle status ({skipped:<reason>} or {missing:[...]}) reported to the flow egress; diagnostics, never persisted as a record.

outputPorts.description: Why a cycle emitted nothing, or which files the listings lacked.

methods.description: Listing responses + list jobs (paired by position) -> for each wanted field the hour's first full-disk scan (scan stamp _s<YYYY><DDD><HH>0, band -M<n>C<band>_ for imagery) as GET requests, byte ranges when the listed size exceeds imager_max_part_bytes, with a parse job per part. One file per invocation; the node yields with the rest as backlog and the runtime resumes it without input. Missing files and failed listings are reported on status; a count mismatch is refused.

wildcardJustification.detail: Per-listing job emitted by plan inside the same flow; never persisted.
